metric_description: max_sigma_dev is the MAXIMUM (not RMS) deviation between convolved H and D fluxes, divided by a conservative constant noise_sigma=0.05. Two cases are computed: (1) thermal (mass-scaled b_H = b_D * sqrt(m_D/m_H)), which is the physical case for thermally-dominated gas; and (2) turbulence-dominated (b_H = b_D), which applies when b_turb >> b_therm. The thermal case determines whether H and D are fundamentally distinguishable; the turbulence case is the optimistic lower bound for TEP.
